sql: begin read only;select jsonb_build_object('application_trigger_count',count(*),'internal_constraint_trigger_count',count(*)filter(where t.tgisinternal),'disabled_application_or_constraint_triggers',count(*)filter(where t.tgenabled='D'),'cron',current_setting('cron.launch_active_jobs'),'net',current_setting('pg_net.batch_size'))from pg_trigger t join pg_class c on c.oid=t.tgrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace join pg_proc p on p.oid=t.tgfoid join pg_namespace f on f.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public'or n.nspname like 'collect_%'or f.nspname='public'or f.nspname like 'collect_%';rollback;
